description: Preview a Zendesk view by constructing conditions and execution settings to see which tickets match. Use when you need to test or validate view conditions before saving, or to retrieve a live preview of tickets matching specific filter criteria without creating a permanent view. This action is useful for verifying view logic, testing conditions, and previewing results before committing to a saved view.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for previewing a Zendesk view.

columns.description: Optional list of column definitions to override or extend the view's columns in the output
columns.human_parameter_description: Optional column definitions to control which ticket fields appear in the preview results.

items.description: Column definition in the view preview response.

url.title: Url

include.description: A comma-separated list of sideloads to include in the response.
include.human_parameter_description: Optional comma-separated list of related resources to include, such as users or groups.

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.
page.human_parameter_description: For large result sets, specify the page number or cursor for pagination.
page.title: Page

view.description: The view object containing title, conditions, and execution settings to preview
view.human_parameter_description: Define the view to preview by specifying the title, conditions (all/any), and optionally execution settings (columns, sorting).

conditions.description: The conditions that define which tickets match this view
conditions.human_parameter_description: Define the filtering logic using 'all' (AND) and 'any' (OR) conditions. Each condition needs 'field', 'operator', and 'value'.

all.description: Conditions that must ALL be true for the view to match tickets. Each condition has 'field', 'operator', and 'value' properties.
all.human_parameter_description: A list of conditions where ALL must be satisfied. Each condition is an object with 'field' (e.g., status), 'operator' (e.g., is, is_not, contains), and 'value'.

any.description: Conditions where ANY one being true results in the view matching tickets.
any.human_parameter_description: A list of conditions where ANY one being true is sufficient. Useful for OR logic across different fields.
any.title: Any
